text: Get the meaning of a word from its context.
zh: 從前文後理來推斷一個字的意思。
author: BraveSentry

text: Seen at a distance, the rock looks like a human face.
zh: 從遠處看，岩石像一張人的臉。
author: sysko

text: I don't remember my parents ever spanking me.
zh: 我記不起父母曾經打過我。
author: dcampbell

text: They had to put that project on the backburner until financing was arranged.
zh: 他們必須暫時擱置這個計畫，直到籌措到資金。
author: \N

text: I suggest you don't go blabbing it around. Your husband would take it really hard.
zh: 我建議你不要到處亂說，你丈夫會非常生氣的。
author: cl

text: "Where's your book?" "On the table."
zh: 「你的書在哪？」「在桌上。」
author: BraveSentry

text: The sunlit side of the barn was steaming after the brief rain shower.
zh: 短暫陣雨過後，穀倉向陽的一側冒著水氣。
author: Auride

text: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
zh: 花光他們所有的錢會很荒謬。
author: Auride

text: We were waiting for him over a cup of coffee.
zh: 我們邊喝咖啡邊等他。
author: BraveSentry

text: The internet is an immeasurable resource of information.
zh: 網際網路是一種無法估量的資訊資源。
author: Sean_Benward

text: I feel dizzy.
zh: 我頭暈。
author: Auride

text: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
zh: 花代價所換來的一點才智，抵過別人傳授的數倍不止。
author: Auride

text: I'm sorry I can't join you today. I have to run a lot of errands before this evening.
zh: 抱歉今天無法陪您，我必須在傍晚前辦很多差事。
author: osdedicados

text: Tom bought a new cutting board for Mary's kitchen.
zh: 湯姆為瑪麗的廚房買了一塊新的砧板。
author: BraveSentry

text: Why do you think animals dread fire?
zh: 你覺得動物為什麼會怕火呢？
author: Nero

text: Male elephant seals can weigh up to 10 times more than females.
zh: 雄性海豹體重可達雌性的十倍。
author: BraveSentry

text: Tom drank a latte.
zh: 湯姆喝了一杯拿鐵。
author: BraveSentry

text: Are you sure the book is on this shelf?
zh: 您確定那本書在這個書架上？
author: sysko

text: Do we have grated cheese?
zh: 我們有磨碎起司嗎？
author: BraveSentry

text: The duck ate pineapple.
zh: 那隻鴨子吃鳳梨。
author: Kritter

text: Is a common European identity possible?
zh: 歐洲人統一有可能嗎？
author: Auride

text: If you prick us, do we not bleed?
zh: 你們要是用刀劍刺向我們，我們難道不會流血嗎？
author: BraveSentry

text: My English is perfect!
zh: 我的英語很完美！
author: lowteq

text: India is populous.
zh: 印度人口眾多。
author: Auride

text: Mrs. Smith is our English teacher.
zh: 史密斯太太是我們的英語老師。
author: Auride

text: That's a felony.
zh: 這是一項重罪。
author: Auride

text: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.
zh: 這台顯微鏡能把物體放大一百倍。
author: osdedicados

text: How long does it take to get to the train station?
zh: 去火車站要多久？
author: fucongcong

text: Since the letter was from Tom, Maria was convinced that a secret message was hidden in its banal contents.
zh: 由於信件來自湯姆，瑪麗亞深信其內容隱藏著秘密訊息。
author: Auride

text: How many calories does a child of 7 to 10 need?
zh: 七到十歲的孩子需要多少熱量？
author: vlecomte

text: Unicorns should exist.
zh: 獨角獸應該存在。
author: fucongcong

text: When it's dusk in Germany, it's late at night in Japan.
zh: 當德國進入黃昏時，日本已是深夜。
author: Kritter

text: I liked Tom's first book more than the second.
zh: 相比第二本，我更喜歡湯姆的第一本書。
author: rul

text: The floor is carpeted.
zh: 地板上鋪著地毯。
author: sysko

text: Tom and Mary are both indecisive.
zh: 湯姆和瑪麗都很猶豫不決。
author: mhattick

text: Do you have any idea what time is kickoff?
zh: 你知道什麼時候要中線開球嗎？
author: Them

text: Do you know who invented the telegraph?
zh: 你知道誰發明了電報機嗎？
author: fucongcong

text: Number 26 is already reserved, sorry.
zh: 26號已經有預約了。很抱歉。
author: fal

text: How come your fingerprints are on this glass?
zh: 你的指紋怎麼會在這個玻璃杯上?
author: BraveSentry

text: I don't think Tom knows that Mary isn't happy.
zh: 我認為湯姆不知道瑪麗不開心。
author: BraveSentry

text: Which brand of toilet paper do you usually buy?
zh: 你通常買哪家的手紙呢？
author: fucongcong

text: Boston is too cold for me, let alone Chicago.
zh: 波士頓對我來說已經太冷了，更遑論是芝加哥。
author: Sean_Benward

text: You don't seem to be as frantic as Tom seems to be.
zh: 你看起來不像湯姆那麼慌亂。
author: Auride

text: Traffic is being diverted onto Highway 7.
zh: 交通正被改道至七號高速公路。
author: Them

text: Prices have reached a 13-year high.
zh: 價格已經達到了十三年以來的最高點。
author: Auride

text: Both Tom and Mary were limping.
zh: 湯姆和瑪麗都一瘸一拐。
author: sysko

text: Though it is poor in natural resources, Japan has become an economic superpower thanks to international trade.
zh: 日本即便是自然資源匱乏，卻仍得益於國際貿易，成為了一個強大的經濟體。
author: Auride

text: During the 15th century, the Ryukyu Kingdom was a tributary state of Imperial China.
zh: 在15世紀，琉球王國是中國帝國的附庸國。
author: fucongcong

text: In case of fire, call 119.
zh: 若有火警，撥打119。
author: dcampbell

text: In Esperanto there are only 16 grammar rules.
zh: 世界語只有16個語法規則。
author: Auride
